rows.label: tlk42100152_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Be careful of the information broker
in Superbia. That broker's a pro.

rows.label: tlk42100152_04_msg0002
rows.name:
That broker usually puts on a friendly
face, but it's a trap. There's nothing
the broker won't do for information.

rows.label: tlk42100152_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Looking into those eyes feels like
having the depths of my heart exposed.
It makes me uneasy.

rows.label: tlk42100152_04_msg0004
rows.name:
That broker even tries to get
information from a fox like me.
That's one frightening broker.
